<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="תשרי_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518914519_theRebbe_363" batchId="meluket-_D7_AA_D7_A9_D7_A8_D7_99_meluket__BH_POST_1766518914519_theRebbe_363__p002">
  <section v="3">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains the difference between the First Tablets and the Second Tablets in terms of divine service, where the First Tablets represent the service of the righteous given from above without awakening from below, while the Second Tablets represent the service of repentance through an awakening from below.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">3)</t>
    <t s="1">And this will be understood by first prefacing the matter of the First Tablets and the Last Tablets in the service of man.</t>
    <t s="2">For behold, the primary intent of the Giving of the Torah is that there should be the reception of the Torah,</t>
    <t s="3">the service of man.</t>
    <t s="4">For the First Tablets are the matter of the service of the righteous, and the Last Tablets are the matter of the service of the penitent.</t>
    <t s="5">And the superiority of the Last Tablets over the First Tablets is because the service of repentance is more elevated than the service of the righteous.</t>
    <t s="6">And the explanation is,</t>
    <t s="7">For behold, the general distinction between the First Tablets and the Last Tablets is that the giving of the First Tablets was from the aspect of Above,</t>
    <t s="8">"And Hashem descended upon Mount Sinai."</t>
    <t s="9">For although the revelation of the Giving of the Torah also affected the world and even its inanimate objects,</t>
    <t s="10">to the extent that the world</t>
    <t s="11">(even its inanimate objects)</t>
    <t s="12">was permeated by the revelation of the Giving of the Torah,</t>
    <t s="13">nevertheless, this was not that a permanent refinement and ascent was made in the world,</t>
    <t s="14">but only that the revelation from Above shone within it.</t>
    <t s="15">And likewise regarding Israel,</t>
    <t s="16">that what the revelation of the Giving of the Torah also affected the body</t>
    <t s="17">(that their impurity ceased)</t>
    <t s="18">was from the aspect of the soul.</t>
    <t s="19">For at the time of the Giving of the Torah, there was for them a revelation of the essence of the soul,</t>
    <t s="20">the level of Yechidah</t>
    <t s="21">[which is not an existence unto itself, and its entire existence is that it is a vessel and receiver from the level of Yechidah],</t>
    <t s="22">and since even the level of Yechidah is connected to the body,</t>
    <t s="23">therefore,</t>
    <t s="24">the revelation of the level of Yechidah also shone in the body,</t>
    <t s="25">even in the aspect of its "heel,"</t>
    <t s="26">and like the statement regarding Avraham,</t>
    <t s="27">"Because [eikev] Avraham hearkened to My voice,"</t>
    <t s="28">And the reason for this is because the revelation of the Giving of the Torah was in a manner of an arousal from Above without an arousal from below,</t>
    <t s="29">for although there was the service of the Counting of the Omer during the seven weeks between the Exodus from Egypt and the Giving of the Torah,</t>
    <t s="30">behold it is understood,</t>
    <t s="31">that through this service</t>
    <t s="32">(during the forty-nine days and fifty days)</t>
    <t s="33">they were not of a level to be in the aspect of a vessel for the revelation of the Giving of the Torah,</t>
    <t s="34">but rather,</t>
    <t s="35">the revelation of the Giving of the Torah was in a manner of an arousal from Above from His own accord,</t>
    <t s="36">"And I [He] began,"</t>
    <t s="37">And what was necessary for there to be service before the Giving of the Torah was only in a manner of preparation alone.</t>
    <t s="38">And analogous to what is explained in many places</t>
    <t s="39">regarding the difference between an arousal from Above that is commensurate with the arousal from below, and the arousal from Above that comes in a manner of a gift, where the arousal from below does not reach there at all,</t>
    <t s="40">for although even the arousal from Above that is in the manner of a gift is drawn specifically after the precedence of the arousal from below</t>
    <t s="41">(and the arousal from Above commensurate with the arousal from below),</t>
    <t s="42">nevertheless, this is not that the arousal from below draws it,</t>
    <t s="43">for the drawing of this arousal from Above is from a level that the arousal from below does not reach there,</t>
    <t s="44">and that it is drawn after the precedence of the arousal from below</t>
    <t s="45">(and the arousal from Above commensurate with the arousal from below)</t>
    <t s="46">is because the Holy One, blessed be He, does not dwell except in a complete place.</t>
    <t s="47">That likewise is also regarding the service during the seven weeks before the Giving of the Torah, that the service was not a vessel for the revelation of the Giving of the Torah</t>
    <t s="48">(and it is not applicable to say that the service drew the revelation of the Giving of the Torah),</t>
    <t s="49">and only in a manner of preparation alone,</t>
    <t s="50">that through their service they became a sort of vessel</t>
    <t s="51">(but not an actual vessel)</t>
    <t s="52">for the revelation of the Giving of the Torah.</t>
    <t s="53">And this itself</t>
    <t s="54">(that they were a sort of vessel for the revelation of the Giving of the Torah)</t>
    <t s="55">is from the aspect of their root and source,</t>
    <t s="56">from the aspect of the Patriarchs and Matriarchs, until "Avraham was one,"</t>
    <t s="57">therefore there is</t>
    <t s="58">(it is possible to say)</t>
    <t s="59">in the writings of the AriZal</t>
    <t s="60">that the matter of the Giving of the Torah began in the days of the Patriarchs.</t>
    <t s="61">For all this was in the First Tablets.</t>
    <t s="62">However, the giving of the Last Tablets was through an arousal from below.</t>
    <t s="63">For the service of repentance of the Children of Israel</t>
    <t s="64">(regarding the sin of the Golden Calf)</t>
    <t s="65">was an arousal from below that aroused and drew the revelation of the Last Tablets.</t>
    <t s="66">And this is why the giving of the Last Tablets was in the month of Tishrei,</t>
    <t s="67">for the matters of the month of Tishrei come through the service of Elul, which is a vessel and an arousal from below that arouses and draws the matters of Tishrei.</t>
    <t s="68">And therefore, through this, a refinement and ascent is made even in the lower realm from its own aspect</t>
    <t s="69">(unlike the First Tablets).</t>
    <t s="70">And this is that the First Tablets and the Last Tablets in the service of man are the service of the righteous and the service of repentance,</t>
    <t s="71">for the service of the righteous</t>
    <t s="72">(including also the drawing down through service)</t>
    <t s="73">is in the aspect of direct light,</t>
    <t s="74">from above to below,</t>
    <t s="75">however, through the service of repentance, a new thing is effected,</t>
    <t s="76">that also the lower realm itself becomes refined and elevated.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="4">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the service of the righteous, being according to their innate nature, does not produce a true innovation, and this applies both to man and to the supernal realms.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">4)</t>
    <t s="1">And the explanation is,</t>
    <t s="2">that the service of the righteous is when a person is in a state of "G-d made man upright,"</t>
    <t s="3">for every Jew, in whatever state he desires, is by his nature to fulfill the will of his Creator</t>
    <t s="4">(as per the well-known ruling)</t>
    <t s="5">in the study of Torah, the performance of mitzvos, and the service of prayer,</t>
    <t s="6">and therefore, through the service of the righteous, no true renewal is made,</t>
    <t s="7">since the service is according to the nature of their innate disposition.</t>
    <t s="8">And just as the service of the righteous is not a true innovation in the person, since the service is according to the nature of his innate disposition,</t>
    <t s="9">likewise is it also regarding the matters above,</t>
    <t s="10">since the intent of creation</t>
    <t s="11">(from the outset)</t>
    <t s="12">is in order to bestow goodness upon His creations, etc.</t>
    <t s="13">(through their service in Torah and mitzvos)</t>
    <t s="14">from the nature</t>
    <t s="15">of the Good to do good.</t>
    <t s="16">And so it is also on a higher level, in the aspect of the root of souls as they are rooted in His Essence,</t>
    <t s="17">according to the teaching of the Maggid of Mezeritch</t>
    <t s="18">regarding "In whom</t>
    <t s="19">did He consult? In the souls of the righteous,"</t>
    <t s="20">that it can be said that this matter is in His Essence</t>
    <t s="21">(above the level of the nature of the Good to do good),</t>
    <t s="22">for since even initially, the delight that He would delight in the service of the righteous arose before Him,</t>
    <t s="23">behold, through the service of the righteous</t>
    <t s="24">(in actuality)</t>
    <t s="25">there is no true innovation.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="5">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the true ultimate intent, above even the consultation with the souls of the righteous, is achieved specifically through the service of repentance, which brings about a new creation and the future redemption.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">For all this is regarding the service of the righteous,</t>
    <t s="1">and as the precise language of our Sages: "In whom did He consult? In the souls of the righteous."</t>
    <t s="2">However, the true intent</t>
    <t s="3">(which is above even the level of "In whom did He consult")</t>
    <t s="4">is as it is written,</t>
    <t s="5">"Which G-d created to do,"</t>
    <t s="6">"to do, to repair,"</t>
    <t s="7">that man, through his service, should make an innovation in creation,</t>
    <t s="8">that there will be</t>
    <t s="9">(not only "These are the generations of the heavens and the earth when they were created,"</t>
    <t s="10">"generations" [toldos] full,</t>
    <t s="11">"the world was created in its fullness,"</t>
    <t s="12">but also)</t>
    <t s="13">"These are the generations of Peretz,"</t>
    <t s="14">"generations" [toldos] full,</t>
    <t s="15">above "These are the generations of the heavens and the earth,"</t>
    <t s="16">Peretz is Moshiach, of whom it is said,</t>
    <t s="17">"The breaker [Poretz] has gone up before them,"</t>
    <t s="18">that then the world will be above how it was at the beginning of creation, that "the world was created in its fullness"</t>
    <t s="19">(rather "new heavens and a new earth").</t>
    <t s="20">And so it is also regarding the souls of Israel,</t>
    <t s="21">that the souls of the future will be higher even than Adam HaRishon as he was before the sin,</t>
    <t s="22">and as explained in Likkutei Torah at its conclusion and seal,</t>
    <t s="23">regarding the new souls that will be in the future, which are higher than all the souls that were included in Adam HaRishon.</t>
    <t s="24">For this innovation is made specifically through the service of repentance,</t>
    <t s="25">for this is what Moshiach</t>
    <t s="26">(specifically)</t>
    <t s="27">"comes to bring the righteous to repentance."</t>
    <t s="28">And through this, the true intent is completed,</t>
    <t s="29">which is above the matter of "In whom did He consult? In the souls of the righteous."</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
